newsitem.title: UK: General Accident up as investors switch. [CORRECTED 1235 GMT]
newsitem.headline: General Accident up as investors switch. [CORRECTED 1235 GMT]

text.p: Shares in General Accident Plc rose on Thursday as investors switched into the UK insurer and market makers found themselves short in the stock, dealers said.
By 0928 GMT, the stock was up 19-1/2p at 911p on volume of 570,000 shares.
"A big buyer came in yesterday. He switched out from other insurer", a trader said, adding the stock was also squeezed higher as some were short of it.
He saw switches from Legal & General Group Plc and Royal & Sun Alliance Plc into General Accident.
Apart from that, the shares bounced back as they were oversold recently, another trader said.
